title: TransportConfig consumed at construction, not stored — correct ownership model
description: The comment in auth.rs explains why there is no Arc<dyn TransportConfig> blanket impl: TransportConfig is consumed once to build the reqwest::Client. The Client is what's stored and cloned (it's already Arc-based internally). Storing TransportConfig would imply it is shared or reusable, which it is not. A future contributor might add Arc<dyn TransportConfig> for 'symmetry' with Arc<dyn AuthProvider>. That would be wrong. The comment is a good decision record.
